description: wi_permissions history after the canonical October 28 update. Placeholders in angle brackets are server-generated or taken from the preview; they are rules, not literal IDs.

placeholders.<effective_at>: preview_created_at from the server; not model-chosen and not a fixed time of day
placeholders.<new_decision_id>: server-generated ID of the Decision created on confirm
placeholders.<new_forecast_id>: server-generated ID of the new Forecast

rules: Exactly two accepted forecasts for wi_permissions; the old one is kept, not deleted.
previous.valid_to equals current.valid_from (half-open intervals, no gap, no overlap).
History is ordered by valid_from ascending.
